chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya, who said:

I asked him about the prayer of the two Eids, so he said: 'Two rak'at. There is nothing before them and nothing after them, and there is neither an Adhan nor an Iqamah in them. He exalts Allah with twelve Takbirs in them. He begins by exalting Allah and commencing the prayer.'

Then he recites the Opening of the Book, then he recites 'By the Sun and its brightness', then he exalts Allah with five Takbirs. Then he exalts Allah and bows, so his bowing is with the seventh (Takbir). Then he prostrates two prostrations.

Then he stands and recites the Opening of the Book and 'Has there come to you the report of the Overwhelming?' Then he exalts Allah with four Takbirs, prostrates two prostrations, recites the Tashahhud, and gives the Salam.
He said: 'And thus did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) do. And the sermon is after the prayer. It was only Uthman who innovated the sermon to be before the prayer.'
And when the Imam delivers the sermon, let him sit for a little while between the two sermons.
And it is befitting for the Imam to wear a Burda (cloak) on the day of the two Eids, and to wear a turban, whether it is Shati (a type of turban) or Qaiz (a simple head covering).
And he should go out to the open ground where he can look at the horizons of the sky, and he should not pray upon a woven mat, nor prostrate upon it.
And indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to go out to Al-Baqi', so he would lead the people in prayer.

key_terms.شَاتِيًا: A type of turban or head covering
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْعِيدَيْنِ: Prayer of the two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)
key_terms.فَاتِحَةُ الْكِابِ: The Opening of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha)
key_terms.وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا: By the Sun and its brightness (Surah Ash-Shams)
key_terms.وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ: Has there come to you the report of the Overwhelming (Surah Al-Ghashiyah)

ai.seo_question: What is the correct method and etiquette for performing the Eid prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the distinct Shia jurisprudence for Eid prayers, emphasizing the twelve Takbirs and the post-prayer sermon as the Prophetic norm, while attributing the pre-prayer sermon to Uthman's innovation. It further highlights the ritual etiquette of the Imam, including specific attire and the preference for praying in open spaces rather than on mats, reflecting the outward manifestation of joy and community gathering.
